className.description: Custom class name for the chat panel container

title.description: Custom title displayed in the chat panel header

hideLogo.description: Hide the default brand/logo in the chat panel header (default: false).

logoUrl.description: Replace the default brand with a custom logo image URL.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the Starchild web app. Defaults to https://iamstarchild.com

tradingAuthorization.description:
Set to `false` to disable the built-in one-click authorization flow.
Defaults to `true`. Ignored when `getOrderlyCredentials` is provided.

brokerId.description: Overrides the `brokerId` read from the host's Orderly config store.

networkId.description: Overrides the `networkId` read from the host's Orderly config store.
